title: Investigate initial nested-repeat instances in XLSForm conversion
problem: Issue #821 reports inconsistent concrete initial instances for nested repeats. Existing tests check template/concrete presence without constraining ancestor template status, so they do not by themselves establish the intended structure for adding new outer repeats.
humanitarian_relevance: Reliable repeat structure supports field-data forms in ODK. No verified data loss or high-impact outcome is established; the related client discussion describes the form as usable.

evidence.claim: lognaturel reports repeated encounters and requests investigating effort for consistent initial instances at all nesting depths. This is not approval of a Humanifest implementation.

Initial source audit located distinct direct-repeat and ordinary-section recursion paths and two existing test assertions that leave ancestor template status unconstrained. The subsequent runtime source below verifies the hypothesis.

65 unchanged repeat tests pass, one upstream performance test remains skipped, and two Java-only tests are deferred. Fifteen actual converter cases show a concrete inner instance absent under directly nested outer templates but present with an intervening group. Defaults and sibling controls survive. No client behavior was tested.

code_surface: pyxform/section.py Section.xml_instance and RepeatingSection.xml_instance_template; tests/test_repeat.py test_repeat_adding_template_and_instance and grouped variant at pinned master 26006d0830570ffa3caead24b0c9a470278af2cf.
proposed_change: Share the verified ancestor-specific XML matrix and effort boundary if the contribution pathway is accepted; agree template uniqueness, initial children, defaults and client compatibility before implementing. Keep #462 repeat-count policy separate unless maintainers confirm overlap.
tests: Focused unchanged baseline: 65 passed, one upstream skip and two explicitly deferred Java-only empty-repeat tests. Fifteen actual convert() cases cover one-to-three levels, direct/group-separated nesting, repeat_count absent/zero/two, defaults and a sibling. Ancestor-specific assertions verify the structural difference; full suite, Java validation, client rendering and submissions remain untested. See research/2026-09-09-pyxform-repeat-runtime.md.
environment: Python 3.13.7 isolated venv with seven manifest-pinned wheel dependencies plus resolved et-xmlfile 2.0.0; no project install or source build. Minimal child environment and checked Python network/process guard. All 249 tracked files verified against pinned Git blobs before/after. No Java runtime available; no services or credentials. This is not a full CI or frozen-lock reproduction.
maintainer: Public investigation request supports research. A verification note is prepared in research/2026-09-09-pyxform-repeat-runtime.md but unsent. Accepted Humanifest support scope, bot identity pathway and reviewer commitment remain unconfirmed. Check authorization and fresh discussion before posting.
risks: Arbitrary nesting, groups, default values and repeat_count can affect compatibility across Collect, Web Forms and Enketo. Do not infer submission behavior from XML alone or promise impact from an explicitly noncritical client issue.
